content: xterm.js FitAddon: uses offsetWidth/offsetHeight (pre-transform). Inside CSS-transformed canvas nodes this causes cols/rows mismatch. Resize loop: fit() changes rows → ResizeObserver fires → fit() again. Fix: debounce ResizeObserver 16ms + guard check newCols===terminal.cols. Fixed pixel height on container. Don't call fit() on zoom change, only on layout resize.
